metadata.title: The Crystal Spire
metadata.description: A traveler must navigate a transient tower that materializes only under the cover of midnight to uncover its secrets before the sun rises. Time is your only ally in this fleeting, mysterious encounter.
metadata.author: PiperScenarioLab

act_1.name: The Arrival
act_1.description: The protagonist encounters the mysterious spire and begins the journey.

scene_1.name: Moonlit Edge
scene_1.description: The jagged spire materializes from the darkness behind you.

scene_2.name: The First Gate
scene_2.description: A shimmering barrier blocks the path to the tower.

obj_1.description: Approach the spire without triggering the defensive wards.

act_2.name: The Labyrinth of Riddles
act_2.description: Inside the tower, the protagonist solves riddles to unlock inner chambers.

scene_3.name: The Hall of Echoes
scene_3.description: A riddle speaks in the voice of an ancient master.

scene_4.name: The Inner Sanctum
scene_4.description: The final riddle is solved, revealing the path to the summit.

obj_2.description: Answer the riddles correctly to unlock the summit.

act_3.name: The Departure
act_3.description: The sun rises, and the protagonist claims their reward before the tower fades.

scene_5.name: The Dawn's Touch
scene_5.description: The crystal tower begins to dissolve as light hits it.

scene_6.name: The Hidden Gift
scene_6.description: The protagonist takes the glowing shard before the tower vanishes.

obj_3.description: Retrieve the hidden gift before the tower disappears.

act_3.ending_narration: The sun crests the horizon, causing the tower to dissolve into mist, leaving you with a glowing shard of crystal as the only reminder of your visit. You stand alone in the morning light, the memory of the spire fading with the night, but the shard humming a silent promise in your palm.

npc_01.name: The Whispering Architect

persona.voice: Echoing and layered like multiple voices speaking in unison

knows: The nature of the Riddle of Time
The location of the hidden gift
can_reveal: The answer to the first riddle if a sacrifice is made

npc_02.name: Lumina, the Shadow Stalker

persona.voice: Soft, melodic, but with sudden sharp cracks
motives: To protect the core from corruption
persona.speech_style: Poetic with sudden bursts of urgency

knows: The weakness of the Shadow Stalkers

npc_03.name: Echo of the First

persona.voice: Ancient, deep, resonating in the bones
motives: To complete the final test of the soul

knows: The true cost of the gift
The nature of the Crystal Spire

item_01.name: Shard of Dawn
item_01.description: A glowing, jagged piece of crystal that pulses with the rhythm of a heartbeat. It is warm to the touch and hums when near other crystals.

item_02.name: Chronos Compass
item_02.description: A brass compass that points not North, but towards the nearest moment of significance. The needle spins wildly near the Spire.

item_03.name: Vial of Starlight
item_03.description: A small glass vial containing a swirling blue liquid that never seems to decrease. It can be used to illuminate dark spaces or hide one's presence.

item_04.name: Tapestry of Threads
item_04.description: A woven fabric made of light and shadow. It can be used to create temporary bridges or masks to confuse enemies.

skill_01.name: Crystal Resonance
skill_01.description: Allows the player to sense the structural integrity of crystals and riddle patterns, providing insight into the Spire's puzzles.

skill_02.name: Midnight Stalking
skill_02.description: Grants the ability to move silently through moonlit areas and remain undetected by shadow creatures.

skill_03.name: Riddle Weaver
skill_03.description: Enhances the player's ability to interpret cryptic language and solve riddles based on their emotional and intellectual connection.
